title: Chapter 108 False Victory
content:
Chapter 108 False Victory

[Piercing bomb: A powerful bomb with an explosion radius of 50 meters and 1W damage. ]

Wang Shuo's eyes almost popped out when he saw this introduction, and his hand holding the piercing bomb was shaking.

This...

Fuck...

This is simply a nuclear weapon!

Wang Shuo calmed down.

How can he calm down?

The bronze crossbow car with the highest attack power he has seen so far only has an attack power of 2000.

This piercing bomb can directly deal 1W damage.

A real killer.

Wang Shuo carefully put it away.

For fear that it would explode accidentally.

Just when Wang Shuo was surprised, the other bosses were also killed one by one by Fang Kai and others.

Wang Shuo glanced around and found that the items exploded by the boss were all taken away by them.

He curled his lips and showed a look of contempt.

The other silver boss saw that the situation was over and stopped entangled with Gong Zheng, and ran away with his tail between his legs.

Before leaving, he didn't even say a harsh word.

The people of Wana Village cheered immediately.

"Long live Wana Village!"

"The Lord is mighty!"

"We survived, we won!"

"I survived..."

The cheers of the people came one after another.

However, several people in the know, such as Wang Shuo, Fang Kai and others, did not smile at all, but showed deep worries.

Wang Shuo looked up in the direction of the golden boss.

Toad Brunei seemed to feel something at this time and slowly opened his eyes.

"Now, how is the battle situation now? These little scums, are they all dead, right?" He looked a little lazy and yawned.

The toad guard behind him replied tremblingly: "My Lord, no, there is only one left."

"Uh, it's time for me to warm up!"

Bai Ming ran over in a panic and said to Brunei: "My Lord, the other side is too strong. We didn't fight them. They are all dead."

"They are all dead, how are you still alive?" Brunei glared at him with his huge eyes and scolded.

Without any warning, his tongue rolled.

Bai Ming was entangled by Brunei's tongue, which was thicker than a bucket, and he entered his mouth with a light pull.

The white wolf, which was nearly ten meters long, did not seem crowded in his mouth at all.

Brunei even chewed it twice before swallowing it.

"It tastes so-so."

Just treat it as an appetizer!

Next, it's time to really enjoy the delicious food.

In his eyes, humans and ordinary beasts are just food.

He pushed his hind legs hard, and his mountain-like body jumped directly into the air, at least three stories high.

The distance reached hundreds of meters.

The moment he landed, the ground shook, as if there was an earthquake.

Feel the vibration of the ground.

Just when others were still confused.

Fang Kai was the first to react and said to Dongfang Ling: "Miss, you see there is nothing here, let's leave quickly! This time, Lord Qingyang has given us a mission."

"What mission?" Dongfang Ling's eyes lit up and showed interest.

Because she got in by stealing someone else's opportunity, she didn't know what the mission was.

"The Lord sent us here..."

Before Fang Kai finished speaking, he saw the golden boss Toad leap into the air.

The huge body of the Toad, like a flying hill, scared him directly.

This is definitely not an ordinary golden boss.

Even if Ni Wu was here, he could only flee.

Fang Kai pulled Dongfang Ling and was about to leave.
